text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, today I must practice moderation! I have been slacking a little in that regard lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall hold myself to the same dietary restrictions as yesterday. No, perhaps they should be even more restrictive today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: M-my skin… It seems slightly duller than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Th-this is most certainly the fault of my restrictive diet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't go out in public like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The condition of Mejiro McQueen's skin has worsened due to excessive dieting. As a result, she falls into a slump.
